mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, which drives corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If unemployment exceeds 5% but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When employment increases but unemployment also rises, it indicates potential labor market inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both employment increases and unemployment rises but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates in a tightening cycle increase borrowing costs, reducing corporate investments and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation as indicated by CPI erodes purchasing power and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If CPI increases but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals reduced economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production falls below 100 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth combined with rising unemployment indicates economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth slows and unemployment rises but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts but falling retail sales suggest economic imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts rise and retail sales fall but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.
